question: What meditative and breath-control actions prepare the practitioner for inner ascent?
premises: One meditates on the blazing huṃ-sound
The restraint aims at a motionless state
inference: Meditating on the blazing huṃ-sound and restraining the breaths motionlessly prepares the practitioner.
